artifact_policy: Retain selected validation rows, exact prompts and prompt hashes, token IDs, per-row binary margins and predictions, dataset/model hashes, runtime, resource records, source snapshots, auditor report, and SHA-256 manifest. Preserve non-passes and failures. Do not load the official test split or train/update any model.
claim_boundary: This is a no-update base-policy feasibility screen for a balanced binary transformation of SNLI validation. It can establish only whether the pinned model clears a frozen base-rate screen on these selected rows. It is not post-training evidence, held-out confirmation, external reproduction, or a model-capability/generalization claim. Public-model pretraining exposure cannot be ruled out.

compute_limits.device: CPU only; CUDA and MPS are forbidden
compute_limits.network: Disabled; local_files_only=true and all Hugging Face offline flags set

dataset.selection: Within each binary class on the official validation split, rank valid rows by (SHA256(premise + newline + hypothesis), original row index); select the first 256. Exclude rows whose premise SHA-256 appears in the typed locked pilot denylist, and also exclude any prompt-pair SHA-256 matching a typed legacy text hash. Premise exclusions conservatively remove every hypothesis sharing a premise used in prior pilots. Fail closed for insufficient support, duplicate prompt hashes, or any pilot overlap. This consumes the selected rows for feasibility only.

task.question: Does the hypothesis follow from the premise?
task.action_space: Score exactly the next-token logits for the single-token completions ' A' and ' B'; no generation or continuation. Verify both tokenizations at runtime.
task.option_order: Deterministic per-prompt shuffle keyed by SHA256('snli-binary-order-v1:' + prompt_sha256); the binary label-to-letter mapping is recorded for every selected row.
task.meaning_entailment: the hypothesis follows from the premise
task.meaning_not_entailment: the hypothesis does not follow from the premise

metrics.primary: Balanced accuracy across entailment and not-entailment on the 512 selected, class-balanced validation rows.

paired_bootstrap.method: Resample rows with replacement within each binary gold class and recompute balanced accuracy.

feasibility_gate.result: pass only when every threshold and all provenance/runtime/resource checks pass; otherwise non-pass

metrics.decision_effect: A pass permits design work on a separate frozen post-training study with fresh training/development/confirmation cohorts; it does not authorize training or test-split access in this feasibility run. A non-pass retires this task formulation without changing the gate or reusing the selected rows.

execution.study_and_audit: Separate CPU-only offline processes, each limited to 900 seconds and 6 GiB peak RSS.
